published_prior_art.cite: FoygelDraismaDrton2012HTC — the covariance residual equations are established machinery; the exact coordinate-preserving localization package is a supporting refinement.
GuptaBlaser2024TreeSCM gives the k=0 1/2/infinity tree trichotomy; FoygelDraismaDrton2012HTC gives whole-fiber degrees, not this excess-budget coordinate bound.
FoygelDraismaDrton2012HTC reports finite whole-fiber examples through five vertices, not an all-k branch-separating one-coordinate family.
GuptaBlaser2024TreeSCM settles only the directed-tree boundary, while FoygelDraismaDrton2012HTC supplies whole-fiber rather than single-coordinate degree information.
FoygelDraismaDrton2012HTC performs exhaustive small-graph algebraic computations, but not the proposed rooted-query coordinate-degree census.

DoerflerZanderBlaserLiskiewicz2024Complexity decides generic edge identification in PSPACE; HolleringMisraSturma2026Symbolic searches rational identifying formulas; neither outputs finite algebraic coordinate certificates on tree-plus-k graphs.
Corniquel2026GenericRUR gives generic RUR specialization control for generically zero-dimensional systems; the proposed SEM coordinate-projection packaging is a specialization.

BouzidiLazardPougetRouillier2015RUR supplies general real-algebraic isolation, while DrtonFoygelSullivant2011Global distinguishes real from generic behavior but gives no rootwise supported-SEM lift criterion.

ChernozhukovHongTamer2007SetInference supplies general set-inference architecture and MareisSturmaDrton2026Inference treats rational HTC estimators; the finite algebraic branch specialization is a secondary extension.
MareisSturmaDrton2026Inference gives asymptotic normality for rationally identified half-trek estimators; this is the singleton corollary of the proposed finite-branch inference rung.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Algorithm 2 decides each tree parameter as generically identifiable, 2-identifiable, or unidentifiable; Theorem 27 establishes correctness.

source_verification_receipts.version: 2012 Annals of Statistics electronic reprint of Vol. 40(3), pp. 1682–1713
source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 2–3, equations (1.3)–(1.5); p. 21 Definition 7; p. 24 decomposition theorem
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper uses the same covariance parametrization, defines whole-fiber degree of identifiability, records higher finite degrees on small graphs, and proves multiplication of finite whole-fiber degrees across mixed components.
Corollary 6 states that generic edge identifiability can be decided in PSPACE.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 10, Theorem 4.4; pp. 10–11, Theorem 5.1 and discussion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper characterizes rational identification through degree-bounded Gröbner computations and gives a quasi-polynomial fixed-degree rational-identifiability procedure.
The published paper improves the tree-shaped generic-identification algorithm from O(n^6) to O(n^3 log^2 n) and provides an implementation.
The paper treats generic parametrization and specialization of generically zero-dimensional parametric polynomial systems via rational univariate representations.
The paper derives influence functions, asymptotic normality, and confidence regions for rational half-trek estimators.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make the all-size frontier theorem explicitly compare its recurrence with both the Gupta–Bläser tree trichotomy and the Foygel–Draisma–Drton whole-fiber product degree, including a strict positive-k separation corollary.
Complete and archive the characteristic-zero n≤5, k≤2 census before committing to the recurrence, with each eliminated coordinate checked after exact covariance-only localization.

State a bit-complexity version of the minimal-polynomial algorithm, separating finite-field identity-testing cost, rational reconstruction, and certificate verification from the unit-cost arithmetic bound.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0 with the sharp all-size coordinate-degree frontier as the field-level kernel and retain the census as its mandatory falsification gate.
